hadiths.text_arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
hadiths.text_en: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will be rewarded according to their intention.

hadiths.text_arabic: لاَ تَحَاسَدُوا، وَلاَ تَنَاجَشُوا، وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا، وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا
hadiths.text_en: Do not envy one another; do not outbid one another (in order to raise the price); do not hate one another; and do not turn away from one another.

hadiths.text_arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
hadiths.text_en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

hadiths.text_arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
hadiths.text_en: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

hadiths.text_arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
hadiths.text_en: Whoever takes a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.

hadiths.text_arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَظْلِمُهُ وَلاَ يُسْلِمُهُ
hadiths.text_en: A Muslim is a brother of another Muslim; he does not oppress him, nor does he hand him over (to the enemy).

hadiths.text_arabic: إِذَا لَقِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِ
hadiths.text_en: When one of you meets his brother, let him greet him with peace.

hadiths.text_arabic: نِعْمَتَانِ مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ: الصِّحَّةُ وَالْفَرَاغُ
hadiths.text_en: There are two blessings which many people lose: health and free time.
He who does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.
